slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Make agent tool use visible
slides.subtitle: A silent UI makes working agents feel broken.

slides.title: Silence is confusing
slides.body: If the user asks a question and nothing changes for 20 seconds, the app feels stuck even when the backend is doing useful work.

slides.title: Stream the work
slides.body: Show answer tokens as they arrive. Show tool calls, inputs, and results while the agent is still working.

slides.title: Collapse noisy output
slides.body: Tool results can be long. Keep them visible for debugging, but collapsed by default so the interface stays readable.

slides.title: This is observability
slides.body: Visible tool events show whether retrieval happened, which tool was called, and what data came back before the answer.
